title: Designing dislocation-driven polar vortex networks in twisted perovskites
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11330-9

Experimental and theoretical investigation of twisted freestanding SrTiO3 layers using various analytic methods from 4DSTEM to DFT reveal a long-range ordered screw dislocation pattern as well as topological polar vortex arrays in the interface plane.
